# Convertly-ULTRA

> Free, private, in-browser file converter for images, audio and text files. No ads, no login, no uploads. Created by Reyny Mark Mabeza (https://reynymark.is-a.dev).

## Pages
- [Home / Converter](https://converter-ultra.vercel.app/): Drop files, choose a target format, download. FAQ is at /#faq.
- [Privacy Policy](https://converter-ultra.vercel.app/privacy.html): Files never leave the device; two optional first-party cookies (device ID, visit count) set only after consent.
- [Terms of Use](https://converter-ultra.vercel.app/terms.html): Free to use, provided as is.

## Supported conversions
- Image: PNG, JPG, WebP, BMP, PDF (SVG and GIF as input)
- Audio: WAV, MP3
- Text: TXT, MD, HTML, JSON, CSV, plus PDF and DOCX output (including JSON to CSV and CSV to JSON)
- Video: MP4, WebM, GIF, or MP3/WAV audio extracted from video
- Documents: PDF to TXT, DOCX, PNG, JPG; DOCX to TXT, HTML, PDF
